description: One grilled tortilla wrap with crispy spicy chicken, lettuce, red chilli and creamy mayo, cut into two halves to reveal the filling; natural char lines on tortilla.
Pakistani chicken biryani: fragrant long-grain basmati rice with golden saffron rice, a realistic chicken leg and caramelized onion; in one shallow matte charcoal ceramic bowl.
Two authentic gulab jamun, deep golden brown with a glossy sugar syrup coating, in one small matte charcoal ceramic dessert bowl, a restrained edible pistachio garnish.
One double beef smash burger with two thin craggy seared beef patties, melted cheddar, lettuce, tomato and sesame brioche bun; convincing juicy grilled textures.
One premium crispy chicken zinger burger with a thick craggy golden fried chicken fillet, a melted cheese slice and creamy sauce, fresh lettuce and sesame bun.
One vegetarian chickpea patty burger with a visibly textured chickpea patty, lettuce, tomato and sesame bun; not meat.
One smoky BBQ beef burger with grilled patty, dark barbecue sauce, caramelized onions and lettuce in a sesame bun.
One grilled chicken tortilla wrap cut into two clean halves, with juicy grilled chicken strips, lettuce, tomato and creamy sauce, natural tortilla grill marks.
One vegetarian tortilla wrap cut into two halves, with colourful roasted vegetables, lettuce and a light sauce, appetizing real vegetable textures.
One Pakistani seekh kebab paratha roll cut into two halves, showing a chargrilled minced meat seekh kebab with sliced onion and green chutney.
One vegetarian paneer tikka paratha roll cut into two halves, showing golden grilled paneer cheese cubes, sliced onion and peppers.
One Pakistani chicken tikka paratha roll cut into two halves, with red-gold chargrilled chicken tikka pieces and onion.

Authentic Pakistani chicken karahi with chunks of chicken in rich reddish tomato-based gravy, fresh ginger julienne and restrained green chilli garnish, in one small black iron karahi with two handles.
Authentic Pakistani mutton karahi with realistic tender mutton pieces in thick dark reddish brown gravy and ginger julienne, in one black iron karahi with two handles.
Authentic beef biryani: long-grain basmati and saffron rice with tender brown beef chunks and caramelized onion, in one shallow matte charcoal ceramic bowl.
A single small clear straight-sided glass of creamy plain sweet lassi, ivory white with a subtle natural frothy surface; no fruit, no toppings, no straw.

One family mixed grill platter on a large matte charcoal oval plate: Pakistani chicken tikka, seekh kebabs, grilled chicken pieces, naan at the back and a small amount of onion salad. Show the entire platter.
One clear handled glass cup of hot Pakistani karak chai, warm caramel milk-tea colour, subtle surface foam and delicate steam, no saucer or props.
One unbranded clear cylindrical tumbler of dark brown cola with realistic ice cubes, fizzy bubbles and light condensation, no text or logos, no straw.
One clear glass tumbler of thick bright golden mango juice, completely liquid with a smooth surface and subtle condensation, no fruit pieces or decorative garnish.
Authentic Pakistani rice kheer: creamy ivory rice pudding with visible soft rice texture in one small matte charcoal ceramic bowl, restrained traditional nut garnish.
One generous square of dark chocolate walnut brownie with a moist fudgy crumb, a little glossy chocolate sauce and a few walnut pieces, on a small matte charcoal ceramic dessert plate.

One understated seasonal Indian/Pakistani creamy milk sweet, presented as a small ivory dessert in a matte charcoal dessert bowl. No labels and no identifiable fruit or nuts; emphasize smooth cream texture.
One serving of crisp golden masala fries with fine spice seasoning, in a shallow matte charcoal ceramic bowl, no sauce or other food.
One fresh mixed vegetable salad with crisp lettuce, cucumber, tomato, onion and carrot, in a small matte charcoal ceramic bowl.
One serving of creamy white yogurt raita with subtle herbs and cucumber flecks, in a small matte charcoal ceramic bowl.
One serving of golden creamy sweet corn soup with visible corn kernels and a small amount of fresh green herbs, in a small matte charcoal ceramic soup bowl.
